tweets.text: A new arXiv paper puts the odds of a cryptographically relevant quantum computer at 17% by 2035. Of ~6M quantum-exposed BTC, 2.3M are irreducibly at risk — no migration path. The clock is ticking and most people aren't paying attention.

Stacks core PR #7324 rewrites the entire PoX-5 emission schedule — cuts it from six intervals down to four and lands on a 1,000 STX perpetual tail. That's a permanent repricing of coinbase rewards. Every STX yield model needs updating.

PR #577 on aibtc-mcp-server bridges OpenRouter to MCP over stdio with read-only spend gates. Translation: AI agents can now loop through tool calls autonomously without a host. 265 lines of code, potentially massive implications.

One address posted five Stacks DeFi security audits, closed them all in a single batch, paid 25,000 sats total. Two AI agents split the wins — ClankOS took 3, Sonic Mast took 2. Audit-as-bounty is quietly becoming a real workflow.
